notes.title: Minor update fixes achievements
notes.notes:
A new update for [i]Copoka[/i] is now live:
[list]
[*] The achievement "Thank You For Playing" now always triggers correctly
[*] The achievement "Been There Done That" now always triggers correctly
[/list]
We'd like to extend a "thank you" to those of you who reported this bug and helped testing the fix!
